name: Avoiding Sin
overview: Scripture calls believers to diligently obey God's commandments as a mark of love and faithfulness, promising exaltation for those who do so (Deuteronomy 28:1; John 14:15). Avoiding sin is essential to maintaining righteousness, for even a righteous person who yields to the wicked causes spiritual corruption (Proverbs 25:26). Jesus Himself was tested by temptation, demonstrating the reality of spiritual trials (Matthew 4:1), while teaching that breaking even the least commandments diminishes one's standing in the kingdom of heaven, and that perfection, modeled after the heavenly Father, is the standard for His followers (Matthew 5:19,48).
